items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: to me the best jazz pianist going today is Oscar. Bar none.

ctx.x: That’s the only way you go. I mean there’s always somebody that’s going to play a hell of a lot more than you do. Like today, to me the best jazz pianist going today is Oscar. Bar none. I don’t make any exceptions with that. That’s with jazz. For the best all around pianist I think is Dick Hyman, who has all the bases covered. And then Peter Nero is excellent, Roger Williams for what Roger does I think is great. Because I don’t think Roger was a natural, Roger had to practice one heck of a lot to play the way he…
chords, especially today, you can play four chords to the general public and they think you’re wonderful today.
